label: spike_binding
note: spike binding of the clone (probe sorting / mAb ELISA)

label: elisa
note: ELISA of the clone's expressed mAb

label: tissue
note: fraction of the clone's cells sampled in blood

label: division_gate:mCherry-low
note: fraction of the clone's cells that divided most (mCherry-low gate)

label: rbd_bait:RBD+
note: fraction of the clone's cells binding RBD bait (protein arm)

label: division_gate:mCherry-low
note: fraction of the clone's cells in the mCherry-low gate

label: zone_gate:DZ
note: fraction of the clone's cells sorted as dark zone (mRNA arm)

label: timepoint
note: fraction of the clone's cells sampled at day 7

label: age_group
note: donor age group (donor-level label: not separable from other donor differences)

label: gfp
note: fraction of the clone's d14/d21 cells that are EBV-GFP+

label: severity
note: clinical severity of the donor (donor-level label: not separable from other donor differences)
